subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Sonargaon was i. had a reputation for i. dwelling place in the 19th century. (b) The importance of the city ii. many beautiful buildings on ii. during the Sultani period. (c) The place at that time iii. the capital of Bengal iii. both sides of the road. (d) Many businessmen selected iv. declined during iv. the manufacture of 'Maslin Saree'. (e) They built v. Sonargaon as their v. the next Mughal period.
guide_solution: (a) Sonargaon was the capital of Bengal during the Sultani period. (b) The importance of the city declined during the next Mughal period. (c) The place at that time had a reputation for the manufacture of 'Maslin Saree'. (d) Many businessmen selected many beautiful buildings on both sides of the road. (e) They built Sonargaon as their dwelling place in the 19th century.
